text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe puts on a brilliant 
performance at the St. Lite Kinen. This 
must be the fruit of her preparations 
since spring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her stamina is on the upswing. However, 
concerns remained regarding the condition 
of her hooves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, with encouragement from her 
"friend" and Agnes Tachyon, Manhattan Cafe 
decided to enter the Kikuka Sho.
